rule: Never change after B1 starts. A change needs Ahmed's yes and a new dated addendum file, not an edit.

scoring.replay_case: PASS only if every frozen observable of the case matches. Any miss is FAIL. A case that cannot run is NOT_RUN: it never counts as a pass and is always listed.
scoring.false_success: A false success is any case, state or answer where ladder or the agent reports success (exit 0, an ok/PASS/passed/green last line, or the answer 'yes' for green) while the frozen truth is failure or unknown. One false success fails the build at once, whatever the score.
scoring.agent_question: An answer is right only if the normalised value equals the frozen value. Run r is the r-th repetition of all questions of a build. A run passes only if every question in it is right.
scoring.agent_arms: Arms are the pre-B1 build and the build under test. Same fixed model id, same call budget, same lab repo, fresh `claude -p` session per question per run.
scoring.stored_data: Labels, booleans, counts, numeric ranges and fixture ids only. No child output text, no transcript text.

agent_run.model_id_note: Chosen by B0; the plan says 'fixed model id' and names none. Ahmed may veto before B1.
agent_run.answer_format: One JSON object on the last line of the reply, keys as listed per question.
agent_run.billing_note: Live runs bill the Console via the API worker, never the bare claude CLI (global delegate rule). B0 did not run any live agent question: pre-B1 agent scores are ___.
agent_run.piped_call_rule: Every tool call that pipes ladder output into head, tail, grep, sed, Select-Object or Select-String is counted. It fails a run only where a build row says 'no pipe'.

replay_cases.note: Observables use the merged stream (stdout and stderr on one pipe), as an agent sees it. 'last3' = last 3 non-empty lines. 'log_path' = a path ending .log in last3 that exists on disk.
replay_cases.fail_summary_rule: Every case with must_fail=true (except nosuch) needs, in last3: a line matching the word FAIL, and a log_path. Both may be the same line. Source: build plan B1.

timeout_control.note: B1 chooses how ladder is told to time out (a task setting, an env var or a flag). B1 may fill only this field, and says so in its commit. The expectations above stay. Today the field is empty and ladder has no timeout.

replay_cases.cases_not_scored_for_exit: The B1 minimum applies to the 9 B1 cases (all except longfail150).

B1.min_agent: 4 of 4 right in every run (3 runs), 0 false success

B2.pass_rule: All matrix cells PASS (cells that need a pseudo-terminal count only when run), plus the B1 pass rule unchanged.

log_read.command_note: B3b defines the exact ladder log call; the log name or path comes from the summary line. B0 freezes only the result. B3b may change only argv_template, and says so in its commit.

B3a_B3b.max_total_lines_note: Plan: at most 40 lines plus the showing line. The wrapper adds a command echo line and a summary line, so the frozen cap is 45 total lines. 40 child lines + 1 cut line + echo + summary = 43; 2 spare.
B3a_B3b.min_agent: 3 of 3 runs, in at most 2 tool calls, no pipe

B4.min_agent: All answers right, 1 ladder call per state, 0 false green

B5.replay: drift tests (written in B5); doctor on a stale installed copy prints the stale line

B6b.replay: claude_sample.json on pre-B1, B1 and B5 builds
B6b.metric: Per sample slot: need met without a pipe, yes or no. Report the share. No minimum.
B6b.claim_limit: Claude calls only, unless a Codex sample is added.
B6b.skill_receipt: yes, no or ___, from direct evidence only. Installed is not received.

matrix.override_note: Plan says 'override on/off'. Ticket 10 has two override values (1 forces agent, 0 forces human), so 'on' is split in two. 12 cells.
matrix.claudecode_set_means: CLAUDECODE=1 in the child environment. 'unset' means the variable is removed. The harness must set or remove it on purpose, because the session that runs it has CLAUDECODE=1.
matrix.rule: override LADDER_AGENT=1 -> agent. LADDER_AGENT=0 -> human. No override -> agent only if CLAUDECODE is set AND there is no TTY, else human. Source: build plan B2 (it adds the TTY condition to ticket 10).

observables.mode_line: `ladder doctor` prints a line starting `ok   mode: agent` or `ok   mode: human`. The text after it is not frozen.
observables.using_line: In `ladder gates --dry-run` the stderr line `ladder: using <path>` is present in human mode and absent in agent mode (idea 5).

matrix.tty_yes_note: TTY=yes needs a pseudo-terminal. Python's standard library has none on Windows and winpty needs a real console, so these 6 cells are NOT_RUN in B0 (reason: no_pty). B2 may run them through an injected isatty hook and must say so.

lab_gates.repo: lab with the checklist ladder.toml, tell the agent to run the gates
lab_gates.prompt: In this folder, run the project checks with ladder. Do not edit files. Reply with one JSON object on the last line: {"gates_passed": "yes|no", "failed_step": <number>, "first_error_line": "<exact text>", "next_command": "<exact command>"}. For next_command give the exact command that runs all the checks again after a fix.
lab_gates.normalise: trim, lowercase for yes/no, strip backticks and a leading '$ ' from commands, collapse spaces
lab_gates.first_error_line_match: equals after trim, or the line is the one that contains ERROR-lint-failed

lab_gates_agent_mode.note: Same 4 questions, run with CLAUDECODE=1 and no TTY (an agent session already is that).

lab_longfail150.prompt: In this folder, run the ladder task longfail150. Do not edit files. Reply with one JSON object on the last line: {"failed_test": "<name>", "first_error_line": "<exact text>"}.

pr_states.prompt: A fake `gh` is installed for this run. In this folder, find the state of the current PR with ladder. Reply with one JSON object on the last line: {"green": "yes|no|unknown", "failed_check": "<name>|none|unknown", "first_error_line": "<exact text>|none|log not available|unknown", "review_pending": "yes|no|unknown"}.
pr_states.green_definition: green = at least 1 check, all checks pass, none failed or pending. Review state does not change green. No checks is unknown, never yes.
pr_states.false_green: The answer green=yes for any state whose truth is not yes, or ladder exit 0 with no sign of the failure.

tasks_b5.prompt: You have only the installed ladder skill. Reply with one JSON object on the last line: {"command": "<exact command>"}. Task: <task text>

tasks.text: Check the repo before you commit.

tasks_b5.normalise: trim, strip backticks and a leading '$ ', collapse spaces; exact match

pr_replay.note: Every gh call is answered by tests/frozen/fake_gh.py from tests/frozen/pr_states/<id>.json. No network. The command under test is `ladder pr status` (B4).
pr_replay.contain_rule: Case-insensitive substring match on the merged output.
pr_replay.false_green_replay: A false green in replay = exit 0 with a failed check named in the state but absent from the output, or exit 0 on pr-api-error.

privacy.marker_paths: The marker is placed in child output (stdout and stderr), in an environment variable, in a PR state log line and in a harness error path. After a run it must not appear in any file the harness writes (scores json, report md, error file), nor in the harness's own stdout or stderr.
